lyrics: 君がいた夏は 遠い夢の中
空に消えてった 打ち上げ花火
君の髪の香りはじけた
浴衣姿がまぶしすぎて
お祭りの夜は胸が騒いだよ
はぐれそうな人ごみの中
｢はなれないで｣出しかけた手を
ポケットに入れて握りしめていた
君がいた夏は 遠い夢の中
空に消えてった 打ち上げ花火
子供みたい金魚すくいに
夢中になって袖がぬれてる
無邪気な横顔がとても可愛いくて
君は好きな綿菓子買って
ご機嫌だけど 少し向こうに
友だち見つけて 離れて歩いた
君がいた夏は 遠い夢の中
空に消えてった 打ち上げ花火
神社の中 石段に座り
ボヤーッとした闇の中で
ざわめきが少し遠く聞こえた
線香花火マッチをつけて
色んな事話したけれど
好きだって事が言えなかった
君がいた夏は 遠い夢の中
空に消えてった 打ち上げ花火

translations.romaji: Kimi ga ita natsu wa tooi yume no naka
translations.english: The summer you were here is inside a distant dream
The fireworks disappeared into the sky

translations.romaji: Kimi no kami no kaori hajiketa
translations.english: The scent of your hair burst forth
Your figure in a yukata was too dazzling

translations.romaji: Omatsuri no yoru wa mune ga sawaida yo
translations.english: My heart raced on the night of the festival
In the crowd where we almost drifted apart
"Don't leave me"—the hand I started to reach out
I put back in my pocket and squeezed tight

translations.romaji: Kimi ga ita natsu wa tooi yume no naka
translations.english: The summer you were here is inside a distant dream
The fireworks disappeared into the sky
Like a child, at the goldfish scooping

translations.romaji: Muchuu ni natte sode ga nureteru
translations.english: You were so absorbed that your sleeve got wet

translations.romaji: Mujaki na yokogao ga totemo kawaikute
translations.english: Your innocent profile was so cute

translations.romaji: Kimi wa suki na watagashi katte
translations.english: You bought your favorite cotton candy
You were in a great mood, but then over there
You spotted a friend and walked away

translations.romaji: Jinja no naka ishidan ni suwari
translations.english: Sitting on the stone steps inside the shrine

translations.romaji: Boyatto shita yami no naka de
translations.english: In the hazy darkness
The bustle sounded a little distant
Lighting a sparkler with a match
We talked about many things, but
I couldn't tell you that I loved you
